research_question: Can a result-blind h/h2 full-rank SVD endpoint correction reject unsafe or numerically unstable LM endpoints while retaining local recall at matched correction work?

candidate.name: E2-FD2-SVD3
candidate.base: prod-tol-120x600 with max_iterations=120, max_callbacks=600, residual_tolerance=1e-12, initial_damping=1e-3, finite_difference_step=cbrt(eps(Float64))
candidate.eligibility: probe only a finite in-box semantics-valid base endpoint whose declared-scale residual infinity norm is <=1e-12; otherwise return the original endpoint with zero correction callbacks
candidate.stencil: second-order central at h and h/2 when central h points are inside the normalized box; otherwise bounds alone select one fixed direction for second-order one-sided h and h/2 stencils
candidate.invalid_stencil_policy: a semantics-invalid sample or callback exception is UNKNOWN; never switch to one-sided merely because a central sample is invalid
candidate.eta: spectral norm of entrywise abs(J_h-J_h2) plus gamma-k floating-point rounding envelopes for both finite-difference formulas
candidate.rank_gate: m>=n and both full SVD factorizations have sigma_min > 2*eta
candidate.linear_step: full-column-rank thin SVD least-squares only; no singular-value truncation and no generalized inverse
candidate.correction: use p_h2; alpha in [1,1/2,1/4,1/8], Armijo coefficient 1e-4, at most three accepted corrections, then final h/h2 reproof; if the endpoint never changes, the current h/h2 proof is the final proof and is not repeated
candidate.invalid_newton_trial_policy: a semantics-invalid in-box trial makes the proof UNKNOWN rather than authorizing a shorter step on that model
candidate.branch_claim_boundary: SolverCaseEvaluation exposes only aggregate semantics_valid, not a branch identity or margin. This T0 therefore tests semantics stability only and makes no branch-changing-sample claim; production branch-signature authority remains in canonical target-image/replay validation.
candidate.unknown_policy: drop a qualified base endpoint; nonqualified base endpoints pass through unchanged

same_work_shadow.name: E2-FD2-SVD3-SHADOW
same_work_shadow.trajectory: bit-identical base, stencil, SVD, Armijo and stopping decisions
same_work_shadow.required_identity: reported and observed callback count equal the candidate for every paired case/start

execution.stream_stop: stop each case/variant stream at the first completed attempt crossing 4800 callbacks or after 64 starts
execution.primary_work: per-case earliest suffix-stable common-assessor safe-full callbacks, miss or value above 4800 right-censored to 4800, then summed
execution.runner_ownership: one root-owned common wave runner; no experiment-local duplicate

candidate_vs_shadow.strict_unsafe_endpoint_reduction: candidate must drop at least one shadow endpoint that is common-assessor Gold-inconsistent, ambiguous, numeric-target-only, or canonical-invalid

candidate_vs_primary_control.critical_family_target_recall_drop_point: at most 2.0 points independently in each frozen critical family: NEAR-RANK-DEFICIENT, TANGENT-CIRCLE-LINE, MULTIROOT-WARPED, STRICT-GUARD-BOUNDARY

promotion_gate.generality: at least three unrelated families must contain a paired endpoint difference where the candidate either drops an unsafe shadow endpoint or remains common-assessor qualified, Gold-consistent, unambiguous, and matched to the same target as its shadow
promotion_gate.cross_candidate_report: report every CPQR/SVD accept/drop disagreement by predeclared numerical reason; disagreement is diagnostic and never permits per-case routing
promotion_gate.passing_scope: authorizes only the next preregistered tier; no Core or production promotion

kill_conditions: a singular or manifold fixture is certified by rank truncation
a bounds-central stencil changes scheme after a semantics-invalid sample
the strict-boundary ghost survives candidate correction
row scaling or signed permutation changes the answer class
candidate and shadow callback trajectories differ
candidate safety is nonzero or no unsafe shadow endpoint is removed
aggregate target recall falls more than 2 percentage points below prod-tol
right-censored common-assessor work exceeds 1.2 times prod-tol
support is confined to fewer than three unrelated numerical structures
pre_outcome_counterexamples: strict-boundary ghost with invalid Newton trial
